reviews.comment: Good prof. Nice guy.

Very caring professor who helps students out a lot and effectively during the office hours. Exams are not hard if you do the practice and mock exams, and homework can be done well if lecture notes are thoroughly reviewed. His lectures could be better, but reviewing the lecture notes and doing Zybooks will certainly set you up for success.

Take any other ecen 248 professor, their exams are a lot easier, and they do reviews that cover the questions on the exam, making it a lot lighter. He is a nice guy, but lectures are boring, and class is challenging, especially the tests.

the morning section of his class collaborated during the second exam, and thus received a higher average than mine. yi either was unaware or ignored this, and my section did not receive a curve. in fact he does not curve at all! he's nice enough, but he could not care less about the grades that his students receive. 248 is supposed to be light lol.

I did not learn about the semiconductors/semiconductor industry. speakers reading off slides word for word, discussions about grad level concepts for sophomores, copy pasted instructions for group essays, & unrelated HW assignments. 289 is a microcosm for the forced push of AI.

exam 1 average was around a 50. he tried to help our exam average by giving us a bonus question on exam 2 but that bonus question was the most awful diagram id ever seen. also he doesn't give partial credit on the exam questions sometimes so that lowers your grade a lot.

I don't know why people say hes a nice guy cause everytime I've asked him questions in office hours or lecture, he doesn't explain questions properly and doesn't seem to care if we need help. His lectures are so hard to follow and he skims over proper explanations of past exam problems.

Okay so the guy is super chill he's genuinely an amazing dude but he isn't quite the lecturer. The lectures are always a little chaotic and he expects us to know everything and doesn't explain things in the best way. Our section also has a horrible TA who grades like this is do or die. The exams had extremely low averages.

He is true to his word, what he says will be on an exam, is almost word for word there. Very accessible and always in students best interest. Lab is tough and homework tedious but they actually help with understanding the material. Very lenient with points and very easy to access outside of class.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Lots of homework

reviews.comment:
Prof Yi has a good lecture, the exam material is clearly explained during class, important lecture topics are mentioned as they come up in class.

The lab for this class is difficult, but it's a department-wide issue. Do yourself a favor, purchase your own breadboard and jumper cable kit, and DO NOT USE the provided breadboards for Labs 1-5.
reviews.ratingTags: EXTRA CREDIT--Clear grading criteria--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Amazing professor and genuinely cares about his students. He's still new to teaching but is always looking for ways to improve and help his students. The labs for this class are a nightmare, but that's another convo. Fairly good at giving immediate applications since his specialty is in digital memory development. Great prof!

Better than Weiping Shi. That's all I'll say.
Also after almost everyone failed Exam 1 he gave 20 points extra credit on Exam 2. So that's good too.

Dr. Suin was extremely helpful near the end of the semester, I went to office hours and was barely making a D but he helped me as I was active in class and office hours. I'd recommend taking the Zybooks I didn't use them but it'll help a lot more than the lectures with learning the material. Lastly, the labs are tedious, make sure to learn prelabs.

Amazing guy, but I'll never understand the hype around Prof. Yi. However, out of all the ECEN profs, he is one of the BETTER options. The only thing that got me through was the labs. Two exams that are 10% each and attendance is 10%. Boring lectures, and he just goes at an unrealistic pace considering it's an introductory digital design course.
reviews.ratingTags: Lots of homework--Lecture heavy--Accessible outside class

reviews.comment: Exam 1 average was a 56. He's nowhere near a 1 star prof but absolutely not 5 stars. Chill guy but you won't learn anything from his lectures as he just scribbles on the slides. You'll hear him talking in binary in your sleep. Best part is you can bring ANYTHING to the exam (I brought about 50 pages of material) and last 2 exams were like practice.
he worked at Samsung which was cool. If u understand the material, the class is an easy A. Attendance being required sucks tho. boring lectures but the slides were useful for exams and homework.

Canvas is almost bare, and hard to access information. His lecture slides he posts and the ones he uses are different and impossible to follow. His class is not hard, but he doesn't explain in class and when asking for clarification, he tells you to "try it yourself. No partial credit on exams. At least the coding is interesting.

The content of the class can be overwhelming, especially if it is new to you. He's able to make it easier by making all of the tests open note, as well as the homework. A lot of the questions on his tests are based on his lectures. I do wish he was better at organizing the important content for the tests.

The material online felt disorganized and made it harder for me to study on certain topics. I think the exams were fairly difficult, however it is open-note and typically the previous exams provided have similar questions to the exams taken. Homework can tank your grade if you are not careful.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Lots of homework--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Dr. Yi is a really great professor that cares a lot about what he teaches and his students. He wants to make sure that you learn and tries his best to set you up for success in his class.

Exams are open note, short weekly hws, and textbooks are optional. His lectures are engaging and cares about his students. Rare ECEN professor who likes to teach and doesn't neglect it for research. Take him.

Prof. Yi was great! His lectures and homework can be difficult, so you'll benefit from reading the optional textbook. However, he does practice problems in class and is extremely helpful during office hours. He's very nice and understanding, and wants his students to succeed.

Tests were open note and similar to the practice exams he posted.

This man is the goat. His lectures are extremely hard to follow to the point where going to class might be useless, but his office hours and TA's are beneficial. He posts exams that are VERY similar to the actual exams, and you could honestly learn everything the night before the exams to make A's. I love this man and his plentiful extra credits.

As long as you are paying attention in lectures, the tests are straightforward. His exam reviews are extremely helpful. His grading is fair and he is a great teacher. While exam averages may be low, your grade is supplemented by an easy attendance grade and lab grades. Homework is hard but the professor is willing to answer questions.
reviews.ratingTags: Clear grading criteria--Gives good feedback--Lecture heavy

reviews.comment: Lectures were hard to follow at times and attendance dropped quickly. Most challenging part of the class was the weekly homework's but if you attended office hours, he was extremely helpful. Tests were pretty similar to is reviews, especially his final. He notices you care about succeeding and will help you get there.

HW and lecture was rough, but Suin (GOAT) Yi is a great professor. He'll help with HW and test topics, just ask. He is super nice, wholesome, and a great professor when you try and reach out to him. W Mans, W Professor, W  Korean Army Soldier, W Ambulance Drive, W Samsung Worker!!!!!!!

Yi was a pretty decent prof for this class. He reviewed the questions for the exams the day before or at least gave us a pretty good idea of what would be on it. Super helpful office hours, especially for hw. Even overrided a bad grade by a TA for lab. Only downside is lectures are hard to follow, you gotta learn primarily from the textbook.
